# Multi-TF Momentum Strategy (Binance Live)
# RSI(14) on 1h + SMA crossover on 4h + Volume confirmation

class MomentumStrategy:
    """
    BUY  when: RSI(1h) < 45 AND price > SMA(4h,20) AND vol > 1.2× avg
    SELL when: RSI(1h) > 65 OR price < SMA(4h,20) × 0.98
    Confidence = weighted_score(RSI:45% + SMA:30% + VOL:25%)
    """

    def evaluate(self, ticker):
        rsi    = ta.rsi(ticker.klines_1h, 14)
        sma    = ta.sma(ticker.klines_4h, 20)
        vol_ok = ticker.volume > ticker.avg_volume * 1.2

        score = self.weighted_score(rsi, sma, vol_ok)
        return score, self.to_signal(score)
